title: FedEx Opens New Global Capabilities Services (GCS) Center in Mexico City
summary: The new GCS center will create more than 500 highly skilled direct jobs by the end of 2026.
body_markdown:
Federal Express Corporation (“FedEx”), the world’s largest express transportation company, continues to strengthen its presence in Mexico with the opening of its new Global Capabilities Services (GCS) Center in Mexico City.


This project involved an investment of $80 million to strengthen the company’s global service capabilities, including the development of world-class facilities equipped with advanced technology and security systems.


The new GCS Center in Mexico City Center will create more than 500 new jobs, with plans to expand its workforce to 1,000 employees, while fostering professional growth and development.


“These facilities will help strengthen our capabilities in strategic areas and reaffirm Mexico as a key destination for global service delivery. FedEx is committed to Mexico, and we will continue providing solutions that contribute to the country’s economic development and competitiveness,” said Jorge L. Torres, vice president of Operations at FedEx Mexico.


The new GCS Center in Mexico City will enable FedEx to centralize key capabilities and provide critical back-office support to its operations across the Americas and around the world through multidisciplinary teams focused on customer experience, finance, and commercial operations, driving more agile processes, continuous innovation, and greater responsiveness.


From this location, FedEx will provide strategic support services to 33 countries across the Americas, from Canada to Argentina.


Notably, Mexico ranks among the company’s most profitable markets worldwide.
With this initiative, FedEx reaffirms its commitment to Mexico, built over 35 years of operations in the country, while fostering the development of local capabilities with a global impact.
